children: Canada's main stock index rose on Friday, as easing oil prices on prospects of a deal to resume shipping in the Middle East buoyed sentiment and helped investors look past rising odds of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike next week.

Traders are now pricing in an 86% chance of a Fed rate hike next week, up from 65% before the data, according to CME Group's FedWatch tool.

"If U.S. rates move higher, that could add some pressure to Canadian financial conditions, but the BoC will likely be watching Canada’s own inflation data and the persistence of higher energy prices when assessing its next move," said Constantino.
The industrial sector (.GSPTTIN) edged 0.4% higher, although it was on track for a fourth straight weekly fall.
